bullets.text: Korakkandandalam villagers besieged the Poondi BDO office demanding basic amenities like roads and electricity, and the office should monitor local panchayat response.
Gummidipoondi surpassed Delhi in air pollution levels according to reports, and the office must coordinate with environmental agencies to review the hazardous index.
Heavy rains lashed Chennai and the meteorological department issued alerts for Thiruvallur and Chengalpattu, requiring the district teams to stay on high alert for waterlogging.
Vehicle owners faced threats after questioning alleged extortion at the Poonamallee RTO checkpost, and the transport department should investigate the staff involved immediately.
The tahsildar announced actions to inspect and remove encroachments on the Dadur lake water supply canal within fifteen days, and the local administration must ensure compliance.
L and T secured a large order for AI computing expansion at the Chennai data centre, and the digital services ministry should track this project for infrastructure growth.
